answers.Is monthly billing a month-to-month memb: No. New Essential and Pro memberships have a 12-month commitment, paid in 12 monthly installments or prepaid annually. Monthly payment is not cancel-anytime billing: current-term installments remain owed. Request a demo or contact sales to get started; new online retail signup is currently unavailable. answers.How does pricing work?: New Essential platform membership is $349 monthly for 12 months ($4,188 platform commitment), or $3,300 prepaid annually. Pro is $649 monthly for 12 months ($7,788 platform commitment), or $6,500 prepaid annually. Prices are USD before applicable tax; role and additional-interview fees are separate. answers.When does my membership term start?: New Essential and Pro agreements show actual start and end dates before signing. The agreement-generation date fixes the 12-month term's start and the end is 12 months later. Payment must succeed for the agreement to take effect and access to activate; it does not move the agreed dates. Enterprise uses its agreed service dates. Check Billing for Stripe's actual payment and renewal schedule. Existing accepted agreements, including earlier 3- and 6-month terms, retain their own dates and obligations.
answers.What is first-role prepay?: First-role prepay is an optional one-time payment when offered in your accepted signup or sales agreement: $359 for Essential or $629 for Pro (USD). This non-refundable credit has no expiration, applies to the first paid role under the same billing account, and does not renew. Request a demo or contact sales for a new membership; existing credits and accepted agreements stay unchanged.
